title: PerfBudgets
description: The threshold file performance-budgets.md refers to as perf-budgets.json, plus the measurements CI compares against it. Format notes and the reference environment declaration live in docs/06-delivery/perf-budgets.md. Two rules are enforced here rather than by review, because both have already been broken once in prose: an unmeasured budget may not carry a number, and a proxy measurement may not omit the masking profile it was taken under.

masking_profile.description: Taken verbatim from ProxyEvent.masking_profile. The two profiles have different budgets and their numbers may never share a time series.

reference_environments.description: Every budget number assumes one of these. A measurement taken anywhere else is not comparable and is not written into the same series.

vault_profile.description: Argon2id profile in force. The default profile costs 256 MiB and every measurement that opens the vault carries that floor, so a number taken under the ci profile is not comparable with one taken under the default.

comparison.description: Which direction violates. Required for a binding budget.

status.description: unmeasured means the number does not exist yet. It is a first class state, not a placeholder to be filled with a guess: an invented threshold produces design decisions that rest on it.

source.description: Where the number comes from, so that relaxing it is traceable to a document rather than to a commit.

measurements.description: Optional. CI appends here; the file is still valid before the first run.

environment_id.description: Must name a declared reference environment. A measurement with no environment is not comparable with anything, which is why the field has no default.

samples.description: Budget verdicts are read off the median of three runs; a single run does not decide.

value.description: The median of samples. Stored rather than recomputed so the series is readable without the runner.
